nodes.name: Build Gate Request
nodes.notes: Builds the cheap Haiku TAK/NIE gate prompt from SW1 trigger inputs.

nodes.name: Research Gate
nodes.notes: Cheap Haiku gate: decides if the task needs web research. onError=continueErrorOutput -> fail-open (NIE path).

value.message: Nie udało się ocenić potrzeby web researchu (brama Haiku) — pomijam research.

parameters.query:
select litellm_model, temperature, max_tokens, price_in_usd_per_1k, price_out_usd_per_1k, impact
from model_routing
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and active = true and modality = 'text'
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

select max_research_rounds, tavily_max_results
from research_parameters
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and active = true
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Resolve Research Inputs
nodes.notes: Resolves research model + depth/results from research_parameters and builds the research prompt. Reads inputs from SW1 trigger (When Called).

nodes.name: Call Research the web
nodes.notes: Runs the agentic web-search loop. onError=continueErrorOutput -> task continues without findings on failure.

value.message: Web research zdegradowany (np. wyczerpano rundy) — wyniki mogą być niepełne.
value.details: =task={{ $('When Called').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; code={{ $('Call Research the web').first().json.web_search_error_code }}; searches={{ $('Call Research the web').first().json.searches }}

value.message: Web research nie powiódł się — zadanie kontynuowane bez wyników z sieci.

nodes.name: Collect Research Results
nodes.notes: Terminal node: all branches (NIE, gate-fail, research-success, research-fail) converge here. Returns { web_findings, web_sources } for the caller.

nodes.name: Resolve Lower Primary
nodes.notes: ADR-047: research runs one tier BELOW the task. Resolve the lower text-tier model via the shared Resolve Lower Tier helper. onError=continueRegularOutput -> DB hiccup degrades to the floor clamp (Pick Primary) instead of CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Pick Primary
nodes.notes: Floor clamp: use the one-tier-below row if present; if the task is at the floor (Niski/unknown -> helper returns floor), research on the task's own routing row (Lookup Research Routing).

nodes.name: Resolve Lower Fallback
nodes.notes: ADR-047: the research fallback is one tier below the research PRIMARY (two below the task), within text modality. Empty at the floor. onError=continueRegularOutput -> no fallback rather than CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Research Fell Back?
nodes.notes: ADR-047: did the research seam fall back one tier? Inline in the degradation path (after Check Research Degradation) so the run stays linear and Collect Research Results still receives exactly one item.

nodes.name: Alert Research Fell Back
nodes.notes: ADR-047 WARN: research served on the one-tier-below fallback model. Loud-but-non-blocking; reconverges to Collect Research Results.

value.message: Web research zdegradowany do modelu zapasowego (fallback o jeden poziom niżej).
value.details: =task={{ $('When Called').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; fallback_model={{ $('Resolve Research Inputs').first().json.fallback_model }}; impact={{ $('When Called').first().json.impact }}
